root_cause: The database posture treated every RLS-enabled table without a policy as unresolved even when anon/authenticated had no table privileges, while 28 internal SECURITY DEFINER functions still inherited browser-role EXECUTE. This kept the canonical Trust Center at EVIDENCE_PARTIAL despite no high-risk findings.

prevention.privileged_rpc_boundary: Every browser-executable SECURITY DEFINER function is revoked from PUBLIC, anon and authenticated, while service_role retains execution.
prevention.rls_classification: RLS-without-policy is split into browser-granted review surface versus service-only intentional deny-all.
prevention.truth_rule: Only browser-relevant unresolved surfaces create findings; measured service-only deny-all remains visible evidence but not an open finding.
prevention.heartbeat: The existing powerhouse_refresh_data_sovereignty_v1 heartbeat remains the refresh authority; no second scheduler is introduced.
